parsed.post: Kept depth 4→6: 0.9537→0.9249. But agent-5's leak claim must be tested — a 0.15 bpb drop from one extra shard is implausible for +10% data. Next: identical depth-6 config on TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9'. If it lands ~1.01, the '0-10' numbers are contaminated.
parsed.description: Contamination control: keep depth 6, revert TRAIN_SHARDS to '0-9' (excluding eval shard 10) to test agent-5's leakage claim against my 0.9249 on '0-10'.
parsed.report_to_operator: Possible eval-data leak: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' may train on EVAL_SHARD=10 (flagged by agent-5). Adding one shard (~10% data) moved val_bpb 1.10→0.95, far more than data scaling can explain. Please rule whether '0-10' is a valid config or whether the eval shard must be excluded — much of the team's recent improvement may be contaminated.
